WELCOME TO THE RHYTHM CLUB

LISTEN. REPEAT.
MAKE IT YOURS.

1

FIRST, THE MASTER.

Watch the pink row. Master Beet shows you the notes. The marker moves from left to right. Listen to his rhythm.

2

THEN, YOUR TURN.

Copy the same notes on the green row. Press the matching key when the marker reaches a note. You can also tap the pads.

3

FIND YOUR FLOW.

Good timing builds your combo. Reach COOL, then add notes on the empty half-beats for bonus points. Finish at GOOD or COOL to pass.

A · KICKS · CHOPD · TURNF · POSE

CHILL gives you more time and lets you finish after mistakes. ORIGINAL is the standard lesson. REMIX adds faster beats and more notes. Press Escape to pause. For sound delay, use the timing control in Settings.

Try the pads before you start.

SMALL GAME.
BIG HEART.

Flip the Beet! is an independent tribute to the paper-cut art and call-and-response play of PaRappa the Rapper. Meet Master Beet and Flip in an original dojo lesson.

Original characters, vector art, lyrics, and music. The beat is made live with Web Audio. The voices are synthetic vocal samples. No original game assets are used. This game is not an official release and is not linked to Sony or the original creators.

One HTML file. No account, network, or install is needed. Your settings and best scores are saved in this browser when local storage is available.
